messages:
Alex R.: heads up — SCIM provisioning to customer 'MapleCo' started failing after the idp cert rotation. SCIM connector logs 403 'audience mismatch' when exchanging the id_token. :confused:
Maria G.: thanks — did the id_token aud change to include the resource server instead of the client_id?
Alex R.: not sure. idp change log shows they added a new audience shim. attaching the snippet from the idp:```
{
  "sub": "user:756",
  "iss": "https://idp.example.com",
  "aud": ["https://scim.redwood.ai", "client-abc"],
  "exp": 1998769000
}
```
Samir B.: if our SCIM proxy expects the aud to be exactly the client_id, that would 403. We support multiple auds but the verifier code path used by the provisioning lambda is strict. :eyes:
Nina K.: can you paste the error trace from the lambda? might be the jwt verifier lib enforcing single-aud semantics.
Alex R.: error log from scim-proxy:
```
2026-03-19T14:22:18Z ERROR auth: token validation failed: audience claim does not contain expected value 'client-abc'
stack: jwt/verify.go:112
```
Maria G.: ok this is the common pattern — some idps started returning aud as array for multi-audience tokens. Our verifier expects a string. Quick fix: update token_verifier config to accept array or normalize in middleware. Longer term: ask idp to include the client_id as a distinct aud entry.
Samir B.: also check the KMS-wrapped signing key rotation — if the kid changed and we pulled a new jwks, the token might be signed by previous key causing other failures later. But the current error is aud mismatch.
Alex R.: will try middleware change. question: do we need a rolling deploy to Dedicated and Hosted so we don't break Private customers?
Maria G.: yes — create a canary rollout for scim-proxy across dedicated pools first, then hosted API. Also add an env flag (ALLOW_AUD_ARRAY=true) for immediate toggle.
Nina K.: for audit logs, add an explicit audit event when aud normalization happens: `audit.identity.aud.normalized` with original claim so compliance can review.
Samir B.: and add a regression eval on the E2E provisioning job to include tokens with aud arrays and string aud. Add a small test harness that signs a token with both variants.
Alex R.: stepping through now. If middleware fix works I'll push a hotfix (patch) and flip the env flag. Will post PR and canary timestamps.
deploy-bot: started rollout scim-proxy v1.6.2-canary to pool:d-4 at 1998765380
Alex R.: rollout succeeded on canary, provisioning to MapleCo retried and passed. leaving ticket open until we ship config change to all pools. :lock:
Maria G.: once merged, send a note to support and ops so they can expect potential idp variations.
Samir B.: FYI add a note in runbook under 'SSO token format changes' and include the jwks/kms rotation checklist.
Nina K.: thanks — closing loop when config is in prod. :white_check_mark:
